北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感-7℃。出门记得多穿点，保暖第一位！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear, but feels like -7℃. Dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感-4℃。湿冷难耐，记得添衣保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like -4℃. Stay warm and dry!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感-1℃。注意防寒保暖，别着凉了呀。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like -1℃. Keep warm and don't catch a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 19℃，体感舒适。适度添减衣物，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy 19℃, comfortable. Adjust clothes, enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天 21℃，体感宜人。湿度较高，注意防潮哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy 21℃, pleasant. High humidity, mind the dampness.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感-3℃。湿冷加剧，请您务必穿暖和！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like -3℃. It's chilly, please dress very warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感-2℃。北风微凉，记得多穿件衣服。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like -2℃. A bit chilly, wear an extra layer.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃。气温不高，出门记得加衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 3℃. Low temperature, remember to layer up.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 2℃。体感偏凉，别忘了保暖哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 2℃. A bit cool, don't forget to keep warm!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 3℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水滋润！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear, feels like 3℃. Dry weather, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆下雨 10℃。湿度大，出门带伞，注意防潮保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is rainy 10℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella, stay warm.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感-24℃。极寒天气，请全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, feels like -24℃. Extreme cold, bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感-20℃。寒风刺骨，注意头部和手脚保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels like -20℃. Biting wind, protect your head, hands, and feet.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 19℃，体感 12℃。风力稍大，早晚添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear 19℃, feels like 12℃. Windy, add layers in morning/evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 6℃。风力较强，记得加件外套防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 6℃. Strong wind, wear a jacket to block it.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感-8℃。风力较大，出门防风保暖是关键！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -8℃. Strong winds, stay warm and wind-protected!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感-14℃。低温寒冷，请务必注意防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -14℃. Freezing cold, please pay attention to keeping warm.
